name: MicroStrategy Incorporated 10.00% Series A Perpetual Strife Preferred Stock
summary: This perpetual preferred equity, identified by the ticker STRF, offers a consistent annual dividend of 10% based on its $100 face value. These cash distributions are disbursed to investors every quarter. It serves as a high-yield vehicle designed for income-centric investors, providing an indirect association with MicroStrategy's substantial Bitcoin asset holdings.
